test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

The policeman told the boys to go home and not move at night during the curfew period.

options.text: The policeman said to the boys, “Go home and not move at night during the curfew period.”
The policeman said to the boys, “Go home and don’t move at night during the curfew period.”
The policeman said to the boys, “You can go home and do not move at night during the curfew period.”
The policeman said to the boys, “Please go home and not move at night during the curfew period.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The policeman said to the boys, “Go home and don’t move at night during the curfew period.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'told' changes to 'said to' in the direct speech part.
 
• The preposition 'to' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• 'not' in the indirect speech changes to 'don't' in the direct speech.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
 

Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *The policeman said to the boys, “Go home and don’t move at night during the curfew period.”*
